source.author: Wan-Jie Zhu
source.title: On Sun's Conjecture concerning Disjoint Cosets
source.publication: International Journal of Modern Mathematics 3 (2008), no. 2, 197–206
source.statement: Theorem 1.1 at k=3: for three pairwise disjoint left cosets of finite-index subgroups of any group, a pair of subgroup indices has gcd at least 3.
source.scope: The primary statement was read. The source's proof was not independently replayed, verified or formally checked. The old R8 source already named this import; no novelty claim.
